# Babellino

> Babellino is an offline AI translator in development with an 8-inch touchscreen and 10 supported languages. No subscription or internet required during use.

No subscription is required. Babellino is being developed for offline translation, with AI running on the device and no internet connection needed during use.
Final hardware, pricing, and availability have not been announced.
The device illustration and sample conversation are illustrative, not final hardware or a live demo.

## 10 supported languages.

- Catalan — Català
- Dutch — Nederlands
- English — English
- French — Français
- German — Deutsch
- Italian — Italiano
- Mandarin Chinese — 普通话
- Portuguese — Português
- Romanian — Română
- Spanish — Español

More languages are coming. [Contact us to request another.](https://babellino.com/#languages)
